rationale.A: ~3.5 km in mixed traffic: Meripellontie at 50 km/h, Hitsaajankatu, Kipparlahdensilmukka and 1.4 km of Kulosaaren puistotie; many unsignalised crossings
rationale.B: ~3 km in traffic on Marjaniementie, Tulisuontie, Hitsaajankatu and Kulosaaren puistotie
rationale.C: Same corridor as B but on the tracks beside Tulisuontie and Hitsaajankatu; still ~1.8 km in traffic (Marjaniementie, Kulosaaren puistotie); 4 lights
rationale.D: Paths via Itäkeskus and Herttoniemi industrial area; only Kulosaaren puistotie and Hiihtomäentie in traffic (~1.3 km); 6 lights
rationale.E: Vuosaari paths, Hedvigin rantapolku and Herttoniemenranta shore path; only the shared 1.1 km of Kulosaaren puistotie in traffic; 4 lights; +4 min
rationale.F: Like D via Siilitie, mostly separated paths beside 40–50 km/h roads, unsignalised trunk-ramp crossings; +7 min

notes: Every candidate rides Kulosaaren puistotie (30 km/h, mixed) for ~1.1 km; no option avoids it. C saves 3 lights for +1 min. E removes A's 50 km/h Meripellontie stretch and ~2.3 km of other mixed traffic for +4 min. B and C use the same streets (carriageway vs side track).
